title: Full body · 23 September
label: 40-MINUTE FULL BODY · DELTS + CALF PT
coachNote: 40-minute session. SUPERSETS: A1 Leg press → A2 DB lateral raise, rest 75 sec × 3. B1 DB bench → B2 Cable row, rest 75–90 sec × 3. C1 Hip thrust → C2 Cable face pull, rest 60–75 sec × 3. Then complete the calf PT block: single-leg standing calf raises 3 × 10 EACH LEG with hand support as needed, full rise, brief top hold, ~3-sec lowering. Do not sacrifice calf PT if time is tight. Optional core finisher only if time remains.

exercises.name: A1 · SUPERSET A — 45° leg press
exercises.note: Record plates added and note whether the load includes the sled.

exercises.name: A2 · SUPERSET A — Dumbbell lateral raise
exercises.note: Controlled medial-delt work. No swinging. After this exercise rest 75 sec, then repeat A1/A2.

exercises.name: B1 · SUPERSET B — Dumbbell bench press
B2 · SUPERSET B — Cable row
exercises.note: After this exercise rest 75–90 sec, then repeat B1/B2.

exercises.name: C1 · SUPERSET C — Hip thrust
exercises.note: Controlled lockout; don't hyperextend the low back.

exercises.name: C2 · SUPERSET C — Cable face pull
exercises.note: Rear delts/scapular control. Pull toward upper face with elbows high but comfortable. After this exercise rest 60–75 sec.

exercises.name: PT · Single-leg standing calf raise
exercises.note: PT PRIORITY. Full rise, brief hold at top, ~3-second lowering. Use hand support as needed. Enter 0 kg if bodyweight only.

exercises.name: OPTIONAL · Hanging leg/knee raise or ab wheel
exercises.note: Optional. If using ab wheel, enter it as the substitution.
